event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
FRA222924 was represented by Martin Kowalski.
The RC was represented by Javier Blanco.
Robert Ohlssen (PRO) was attended the hearing as in observer.
The PTL for the ILCA 7 Yellow fleet was 17:40.
FRA 222924 lodged a scoring enquiry at 16:48 on 11th-08-2025 and the RC gave the answer at 18:30 pm confirming the scoring.
FRA lodged a request for redress at 18:40.
The RC presented video evidence during the hearing.
facts: Race 1 for ILCA 7 Yellow fleet was started under RRS 30.4.

The RC identified the hull of FRA 222924 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark, approximately 5-6 hull lenghts from the RC signal vessel and 3 seconds before her starting signal.
The RC signalled a general recall immediately after the starting signal.
The RC displayed the sail number of FRA 222924 before the next warning signal.
FRA did not sail in race 1.
conclusions: FRA 222924’s score in race 1 was made significantly worse through her own fault. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 64.1(b) are not met. RULES APPLICABLE RRS 30.4, 61.2(b)(3), 61.4(b)(1), and N1.4(b)
